intro.heading: All of Lloret, right at your doorstep
intro.body: At Hotel Casa Mas, location is our greatest strength. Set on the central pedestrian street Sant Pere, you're right at the door of the best shops, three minutes on foot from the sea and five minutes from the main nightclubs. Forget the car and enjoy the essence of Lloret de Mar from the heart of the town centre.

about.heading: In the historic heart of Lloret de Mar
about.description: Hotel Casa Mas sits in the heart of Lloret de Mar, on Carrer de Sant Pere, the main, commercial, pedestrian street of the historic centre. Everything is close by: the beach, three minutes on foot; the shops, on the same street; the nightlife district, five minutes' walk. An unbeatable base to make the most of a destination as popular and lively as Lloret de Mar.
